purpose: 2026-10-10 DFT-informed campaign, S0-01, S0-02, S1-01, S1-02, S2-01, S2-08, S2-14, S2-15, S1-07, S3-12. Generated by analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/make_campaign_configs.py from campaign_matrix.json (entries verbatim, matrix order). Design: analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/CAMPAIGN_DESIGN.md. NOT RUNNABLE (HOLD): see not_runnable_reason.
global_rules: Sequential only: python scripts/run_campaign.py <plan> (C10 plans refuse --workers != 1). Every launch counts, failed or not. Hard cap 200: config/solver.yaml max_launches 260 (= 60 used before C10 + 200) and a C10 label counter (c10_* run IDs in RUN_INDEX <= 200) in run_campaign.py.

run_campaign.py (C10 plans) never re-launches an entry whose label already has a RUN_INDEX row, from this or any other C10 plan (MIN10 vs stage plans): a successful earlier launch is reused, a failed one is reported; --retry ID spends a new (reserve) launch on purpose.
Model file for every entry: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml" (V3 + the overrides = the same solver statements as V2 + the overrides, check_v3_equivalence.py).
After any code change: python analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/regress_all_decks.py must print "unexpected differences 0" before the next launch.

run_campaign.py records a failed launch and CONTINUES; it does not apply any stop rule below. The main session reads results/campaigns/<plan>.json and analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/post_run_checks.py output after each plan and decides.
stop_rules: HOLD: Superseded by the frozen register order (register-rev2-frozen-20261010T1833Z, section 3: S2-11 first): MIN10 would launch S2-01, S2-08, S2-14, S2-15 before S2-11. Its launched entries (S0-01, S0-02, S1-01, S1-02, S1-07) are done; the rest run from campaign_C10_DIAG(_HF).

CAMPAIGN_DESIGN 9: the 10-run minimum set in launch order. Its ids also appear in the stage plans: run_campaign.py reuses their launches there automatically (same label in RUN_INDEX -> no new launch); --remaining stage plans are optional (shorter files).

S0 rules apply to its first two entries. Recommended: launch campaign_C10_S0a_smoke and S0b_smoke first, then this plan via --remaining (it then holds the 8 non-smoke runs), because run_campaign continues after a failed launch.
stop_rules_enforced_by: main session (manual); run_campaign.py enforces the launch budget and refuses runnable=false plans

runs.label: c10_s0_01_2p0
runs.purpose: Smoke 1 / primary shared baseline at 2.0 nm: new DFT laws (fit3 dEc/dEg/dm), quasi-2D NC300, surface tail Nt=Ns/t, constant Nd, shared Qf, mu from the shared law, tmun=0. Checks the new option code path (nc300_override) and that every override reaches the deck.

runs.label: c10_s0_02_2p0
runs.purpose: Smoke 2 / gate-leakage code path and first quantitative leakage result: S0-01 + self-consistent direct/FN-regime tunnelling QTNLSC.EL (qtnl.derivs) through Al2O3/HfO2 with the leakage-maximising oxide set, j.tun logged, oxide mesh 0.25 nm. Must show non-zero I_G and KCL pass; compares I_D(off) and I_G with the 2 nm floor (the smallest).
runs.pre_registered_expectation: I_G at V_G=-3 V of order 1e-15..1e-11 A/um (Codex optimistic FN estimate 3.8e-12 A/um at 3 V), falling by >=3 decades between -3 and -1 V; I_D(off) slope |dlog10 I_D/dV_G| >= 1 dec/V where I_G dominates. Either outcome is reported. The worst set is an optimistic scenario (not a rigorous upper bound: no pinholes, thinning or defects), so floor-scale leakage here is an allowed result, checked by S2-11 (oxide mesh) before it is interpreted.

runs.label: c10_s1_01_6p3
runs.purpose: Primary shared baseline at 6.3 nm (same shared parameters as S0-01; nothing tuned to this film).
runs.pre_registered_expectation: 6.3 nm: on-current several times too high (law mu 6.3 nm ~4x the V1 per-film value) and V_th,cc 0.2-0.4 V low, the known V1/V2 failure pattern

runs.label: c10_s1_02_13p2
runs.purpose: Primary shared baseline at 13.2 nm (same shared parameters as S0-01; nothing tuned to this film).

runs.label: c10_s2_01_13p2
overrides: solver.models=fermi srh temp=300 print trap.tunnel trap.hurkx mass.tunnel=0.2123
runs.purpose: SRH/TAT null test at 13.2 nm: two carriers, background lifetime 1e-9 s and capture cross-sections x100 (1e-13 cm2) - both beyond the reasonable range - plus field-enhanced trap capture (TRAP.TUNNEL, TRAP.HURKX, MASS.TUNNEL = DFT m*(t)). Upper bound on generation current inside the solver.
runs.pre_registered_expectation: I_D(off) - I_D(off, S1-06 or S0-01) <= 1e-20 A/um (COMPUTED bound <= 8e-29 A/um x 1e3 enhancement); floor ratio <= 1e-5. A floor-scale current would contradict the bound -> numerics audit, not a fit.

runs.label: c10_s2_08_13p2
runs.purpose: Gate leakage, quantitative: 13.2 nm, QTNLSC (self-consistent direct/FN-regime tunnelling), worst oxide parameters. Compares I_G and the drain-collected share with the measured floor, and tests flatness in V_G.

runs.label: c10_s2_14_13p2
runs.purpose: Ungated-strip deck (audit 7.11 A) at 13.2 nm with the baseline shared parameters: same film/DOS/Nd/Qf on Al2O3/HfO2 without a gate electrode, V_D stepped 0->0.1->0.7 V. Gives G_strip(t) and I(0.7)/I(0.1). Early run: code check and magnitude; frozen repeats in S6.
runs.pre_registered_expectation: I(0.7 V)/I(0.1 V) = 7.0 +- 0.5 (ohmic film); diffusion form would give 1.02

runs.label: c10_s2_15_2p0
runs.purpose: Ungated-strip deck (audit 7.11 A) at 2.0 nm with the baseline shared parameters: same film/DOS/Nd/Qf on Al2O3/HfO2 without a gate electrode, V_D stepped 0->0.1->0.7 V. Gives G_strip(t) and I(0.7)/I(0.1). Early run: code check and magnitude; frozen repeats in S6.
runs.pre_registered_expectation: I(0.7 V)/I(0.1 V) = 7.0 +- 0.5 (ohmic film); diffusion form would give 1.02

runs.label: c10_s1_07_2p0
runs.purpose: Native check of the offline profiling (Codex review 2026-10-10): S0-01 with Qf +1.0e+12 cm-2 (dV = -q dQf/Cox = -0.1789 V) and MUN x0.6. The shifted+scaled S0-01 curve must reproduce this run before profiling is used in S3/S4.
runs.pre_registered_expectation: |log10 I_native - log10 I_transformed| <= 0.01 dec on every point of the J windows (continuum argument: exact except for SRH R and numerics); worse -> profiling is approximate, every S4 optimum is confirmed natively

runs.label: c10_s3_12_6p3
runs.purpose: IGZO.TOKYO carrier-density mobility at 6.3 nm, GAMMA0 = -0.31 (gamma = 178.4/300 + GAMMA0 = 0.285). First 6.3 nm launch also verifies activation for user.material=IWO (REGIONAL MOBILITY MODEL SUMMARY).
